build.beforeBuildCommand: python3 scripts/build-local-runtime.py --if-needed && python3 scripts/build-mlx-runtime.py --if-needed && python3 scripts/fetch-ripgrep.py --if-needed && bun run --cwd .. build:desktop-runtime && bun run build
